title: Hearty Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: Sour, pillowy empanadas that offer a low-sodium twist with enchilada sauce and beurre-monte for a comforting lunch.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and add the ground beef, breaking it apart with a spoon.
Cook until the beef is browned and crumbly, then drain excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and sauté until the onion becomes translucent.
Stir in the enchilada sauce, beurre-monte sauce, cumin, paprika, and cilantro, then cook for an additional 3 minutes.
Remove the skillet from heat and let the filling cool slightly.
Place a tablespoon of filling onto the center of each empanada dough rectangle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together with a fork to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with beaten egg to promote a golden crust.
Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20 minutes or until the pastry is puffed and golden brown.
Allow the empanadas to cool for a few minutes before serving.
